title: New <Kind> Tab on a browser tab opens a browser tab on its engine, Cmd-T there still opens the New Tab page, and the old id newTab.sameKind still runs
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab
converted from scripts/cmux-next/new-kind-tab-e2e.py (cx-9r5w, #18972), which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

steps.note: a browser tab on about:blank, in the default engine; created/0 is the tab
the browser tab is the selected tab New <Kind> Tab reads
script row 'New <Kind> Tab on a browser tab opens a browser tab on its engine'
script row 'Cmd-T on a browser tab still opens the New Tab page': a person's Cmd-T (newTab.default) never takes the tab's kind
script row 'the old id newTab.sameKind runs Cmd-T's action': an alias of newTab.default (ActionCatalog renamed ids), not a refusal

invariants: of-kind lists one tab more than browser-shown, of kind browser with the engine of open-browser's tab, and webviews at of-kind has no New Tab page more than at browser-shown
new-tab-page lists one tab more than of-kind and its focused tab is the New Tab page, not a browser tab
end lists one tab more than new-tab-page: the old id ran an action, it was not refused
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: that the old id's reply names newTab.default: action.run's `action` member is not part of expect.result
the browser tab row's menu title 'New Browser Tab' (debug.sidebar_rows menu_x/menu_y): no facet records menu item titles
